name: modelResIndex
meaning: DAV resource index of the exported model, or 0xFFFF when the export list was empty. Instances live in the owning object (e.g. Wolf::splashRecord, Wolf::propRecord).

name: secondaryRes
meaning: always set to 0xFFFF = no secondary resource

name: pos
meaning: spawn position, copied from the caller's Vec3s when non-NULL (4 bytes + 2 bytes)

name: classId
meaning: not rotOrFlags: the class id. ScnBody_Init 0x50dcb5 mov cx,[record+0xa] then 0x50dcb9 stores it in ScnObject.classId (+0x38); tools/war_objects.py reads the on-disc type-5 record the same way.

name: rot
meaning: not pad: the record rotation (x, y, z), s16[3] at +0x0C on disc as well as in the synthetic copies.
